title: Nice Garlicky Filipino Vegetable Lumpia
description: A garlicky and snappy Filipino dish featuring Thai chilli jam and wok-hei, perfect for a weeknight meal, this plant-based friendly recipe is made into lumpia form
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the shredded cabbage and grated carrots, cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the Thai chilli jam, salt, and black pepper, stir-fry for another minute.
Lay a lumpia wrapper on a flat surface, place about 1 tablespoon of the vegetable mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with water, fold the bottom half over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Fry the lumpia in hot oil until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Drain the lumpia on paper towels and serve hot.
